name: ghost-interview
description: Ghost Interview (AI Mock Interviewer) — deployment orchestration for a single Render web service that serves the built React SPA and the Express API together.

scripts.render-build: npm --prefix frontend ci --include=dev && npm --prefix frontend run build && npm --prefix backend ci && node -e "const fs=require('fs');const path=require('path');const src=path.resolve('frontend/dist');const dest=path.resolve('backend/public');fs.rmSync(dest,{recursive:true,force:true});fs.mkdirSync(dest,{recursive:true});fs.cpSync(src,dest,{recursive:true});console.log('Copied frontend/dist ->',dest);"
